about.title: Japan in one place in Považská Bystrica
paragraphs: Japanese Tea and Culture Day returns to Považská Bystrica for its third edition in 2026, bringing together Japanese gastronomy, tea, traditional arts, samurai culture, martial arts, talks and exhibitions.
The event takes place on 7 November at Dom kultúry in Považská Bystrica. We will use the main hall and the puppet theatre spaces for performances, presentations, Japanese products and tastings.
Throughout the day you can meet people devoted to Japanese culture, taste authentic food and tea, and experience Japan from up close.
